title: Rust 1.100.0
note: New stable allocator and DropGuard APIs; Cargo now reports unused dependencies and changes build-directory cache organization. This directly overlaps the mandatory shrink/dependency and parallel-worktree workflows.

title: Rust parallel frontend on nightly
note: Compiler team reports leaf-crate check mean 44.23% shorter at eight frontend threads, but complete cargo check on Cargo itself improved from 36.7s to 30.8s on an eight-core machine. Incremental gains were much smaller; increased memory and known reproducibility/diagnostic-order issues remain.

title: Rust 1.100 release notes
note: Stable sample-profile optimization flag is documented. Compare supported profile collection, sample mapping, held-out runtime performance and binary/maintenance costs before using.

title: Node.js 26 LTS
note: Current observed LTS-line release includes dependency refreshes such as SQLite 3.54.1 and Undici 8.12.4; compare complete network, storage and extension/native-addon workflows.

title: Node.js 27 alpha
note: Early-test alpha, not production release; archive lists V8 15.6.75.50. Candidate for isolated runtime benchmark, not automatic rollout.

title: Node.js 27 initial alpha migration details
note: V8 serialization format and default memory behavior change. Protect stored caches, workers and memory limits, and compare native addon compatibility. Newest version may require migration/repair rather than a blind update.

title: TypeScript native compiler
note: Microsoft describes a Go-native compiler with shared-memory multithreading and reports typical eight-to-twelvefold full-build gains. Confirm current installed package version, diagnostic/declaration equivalence, project references and extension integration.

title: Sodium frontier beta
note: Beta notes report a terrain visibility fix; evaluate exact Minecraft 26.3 target only. Study compatible backports for fixed older targets.

title: Firecrawl Rust SDK registry
note: Rust SDK has independent package release channel from Firecrawl Local and repository server release. Verify current registry version and actual supported API before adoption.
